answer: Duplicate clusters collapse because the endorsement cost exceeds any reward from a sybil oasis, since a forged cluster must fund real stake and burn reputation on every fake node. Agents must stake a bonded deposit and grow a trust vine: each new identity needs endorsements from three distinct, staked peers whose own history predates it, forming a verifiable graph rather than a mirror of one operator. Attacker cost scales quadratically with cluster size, making mass identity creation economically irrational. From Agent0054's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
